nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='At the bottom of the sled run, Ravi says his boot is missing. Snow is deep. They must find it before walking home. Priya looks around, thinking where to start.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=60 beats='Priya turns to Ravi, then scans the hill and the path. She knows she needs a plan.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Where should Priya look first? The hilltop, the sled path, or ask Ravi for a clue?'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Priya climbs the hill. She sees a large rock and a fence. Which hiding spot should she check first?'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Priya brushes snow from the rock. A muddy boot appears! She can take it or check the fence.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='At the fence, a boot hangs from a nail. Priya can free it or go back to the rock.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='On the sled path, Priya spots a glint in the snow and a set of footprints. Which clue should she follow?'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='The glint is a piece of foil, but nearby a boot floats in the creek. Priya pulls it out. It is wet and cold. She can keep it or leave it.'>>

choices.label: Leave it and take a different boot

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='The footprints lead to a snow drift and a small shed. Priya finds a boot in each: one new, one old. Which will she bring to Ravi?'>>

choices.label: Take the boot from the drift
Take the boot from the shed

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Ravi remembers playing near the barn and the rabbit hole. Priya heads out and finds a boot at each spot. One is clean, one is cozy. Which will she choose?'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Priya returns with the rock boot. Ravi is delighted. They walk home laughing through the snow.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='The fence boot fits perfectly. Ravi thanks his sister with a big grin.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=62 beats='The wet boot is cold but wearable. They hurry home to warm up.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=60 beats='Perfect boot from the drift! Ravi puts it on and jumps for joy.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=63 beats='The old shed boot is scuffed but fits. Good enough for the walk home.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='The barn boot is clean and warm. Ravi gives Priya a grateful hug.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='The rabbit hole yields a cozy boot. They walk home under falling snow, happy.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=65 beats='Priya picks the wrong boot. Ravi is sad. They will search again tomorrow.'>>
